blocks.text: Terms of use are legal agreements on how a service may be used; breaking them can bring fines, lawsuits or bans; they should be fair and transparent; and users keep rights to privacy, information and withdrawing consent. Spam, spyware, cookies, phishing and pharming threaten privacy and security, and filters, antivirus, cookie management and alertness protect against them. The digital divide creates unequal opportunities and is bridged by equal access to technology. Responsible users evaluate sources, think critically, act as good digital citizens and make content accessible.
